result.rationale: The migration unconditionally does execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'] with no guard for zero rows; unlike the embeddable_hosts query which checks embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0, this query is dereferenced directly, so a fresh install or any site that never persisted embed_category raises IndexError and aborts the migration. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff.
